 CEM FRANCE

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every 
3000 hours of operation. This procedure was applied in 
ABU QIR power plant since 1985 and the final draft is issued in May 2005

The first draft is initiated and 
tested by eng. Ahmed Maharem, accepted by eng. Khalil Aly Khalil general director of Abu Kir PS, 
approved by eng. Aly Anwar 
El-Fayoumy Head Sector of Abu Kir PS, 
ومصدقة 
بواسطة المهندس. منى أحمد الشرقاوي: رئيس التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة WDEPC 
القطاع.

A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Current transformer isolation and proper earthing is required

sections.text: Clean the outer surface of the motor
Clean the cooling paths using the compressed air or brushes
Grease the motor (front and rear) bearing with alvania grease R3 , R2
Check the earth cable if it is in good fixation
Check the connection of the motor if it is in good fixation state
Measure the temperature of the stator
